shortDescription: Circle co-founder and CEO Jeremy Allaire posted on X, citing an official Arc chain post, that Arc chain assets, including USDC and cirCTC, rose from zero to $700 million in one week. According to Odaily, USDC transaction volume on the chain has exceeded $7 billion.

title: Circle Co-Founder Jeremy Allaire Says Arc Chain Assets Reach $700 Million in First Week
